description: The module-level documentation in ipld/cid_util.rs explains the dual-CID design clearly and correctly: canonical CID (0x55 raw, SHA-256 of len-prefixed header+body) for stable deduplication; root CID (0x71 DAG-CBOR) as the IPFS address. The 4-byte header length prefix preventing split-ambiguity collisions is documented with a test. This is the right design and the documentation is exemplary. No change needed.
title: DECISION: dual-CID model (canonical CID for dedup, root CID for IPFS) is correct and well-documented
